entities.summary: Çiler İlhan is a Turkish-Dutch writer. İlhan has been an active writer since her youth. In 1993, she won the Yaşar Nabi Nayır Youth Awards award for one of her short stories. She regularly publishes stories, essays, book reviews, travel pieces and translations in newspapers and magazines. Her first book "Rüya Tacirleri Odası" is a collection of short stories that allude to one another. Her second book entitled "Sürgün" contains interconnected stories whose themes range from the invasion of Iraq to women from Batman, and the fate of laboratory.
